📖 How to use

  1. Add each subscription with cost, billing cycle and renewal date.
  2. See monthly and yearly totals update live.
  3. Watch the renewal countdown to avoid surprise charges.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How are costs compared?

Add each subscription with its cost and billing cycle. Weekly, quarterly and yearly costs are normalized to a monthly equivalent.

How does the renewal countdown work?

Enter the next renewal date and the tool counts down the days remaining, highlighting renewals due within 7 days.

Is my data saved?

Yes — your subscriptions are stored in the browser's localStorage on this device.

Can I remove a subscription?

Use the ✕ button on any row to remove it.

Is this private?

Yes — everything stays in your browser.
